title: NASA's Swift Telescope Is Falling Back to Earth
description:
NASA has ended the science mission of Swift, a space telescope launched in 2004 for a two-year mission that kept hunting gamma-ray bursts for nearly 22 years.
Extra drag from Earth's Sun-swollen upper atmosphere pulled it lower, a robotic rescue failed, and it made its final observation on October 20. Re-entry is expected within weeks.
